initiatives.name: WESPAC Foundation
initiatives.description: Peace and justice organization in Westchester County, NY. Runs organizing and education on criminal justice, immigration, racial equity, environmental justice and militarism, and hosts the annual Westchester Social Forum.

initiatives.name: SURJ Westchester
initiatives.description: Westchester County chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice, which organizes white people against white supremacy. Co-sponsors the Greenburgh Restorative Circle Project listening circles.
